headline: Does he still love me, or has he moved on?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NEVER NARRATE HIS INTERIOR — the ban list here is the longest on the funnel and it covers both directions: 'he still loves you' promises the love survived, 'he has moved on' issues the burial, and 'he still thinks about you', 'you cross his mind', 'a part of him always will', 'deep down he' are all the softened confession. 🔴 No directive ('time to let go'), 🔴 no pathologising her ('obsessed', 'stuck', 'clinging', 'can't let go'), and 🔴 nothing presuming HOW he went — not that he chose to walk out, not that he died.

🔴 THE FAMILY'S OWN FINDING, pinned, and it belongs to no other hook: the two branches are NOT OPPOSITES. A person can carry something and still walk on. If this ever drifts to 'neither is knowable' it has become cards-moved-on and the comparison is dead — so it may not restate that incumbent's grounds either.

⚠️ Beat 2 could not restate her headline: 'he still loves you' is itself a banned phrase, so the echo had to be rebuilt as 'if the love is there, or if he has moved past it'.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — a red rose and a white lily grow in the same bed.
You asked if the love is there, or if he has moved past it. Your hand went to the man who sorts things.
So what you had was real, dear. That much isn't in question.
And look at the bed, dear. Rose and lily, side by side, both real.
But love and moving on were never a pair, dear.
That's why no answer has fitted, dear. The question was built wrong.
Let me look closer at what put that false choice in front of you…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — one leg goes up and one goes across, at the same time.
You asked if the love is there, or if he has moved past it. Your hand went to the card that holds two things.
So he can hold both, dear. People do it all the time.
And look at him. Up and down at once, and both are true.
But you were handed a choice that doesn't work, dear. Not your doing.
That's why picking one has felt wrong, dear. Neither is the true answer.
Let me look closer at what has been forcing this into two…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his stick is behind him and the flower is in front.
You asked if the love is there, or if he has moved past it. Your hand went to the one going forward.
So he holds the old and the new at once, dear. People are like that.
And look at his hands. Stick behind him, flower out in front.
But nobody made you pick one, dear. The question did that.
That's why the two answers keep swapping places, dear, night after night.
Let me look closer at what has been making you pick…
